entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: A Dominarian star-shaped artifact that bound its wearer to the earth, preventing planeswalking or being summoned, and increased their power.

entities.name: Samiks
entities.description: Of the Marked Ones; first known wielder of the Nova Pentacle.

entities.name: Zaraya
entities.description: Leader of the Knights of Kjeldor who received the pentacle from Samiks.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Used the pentacle against Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Enemy against whom the pentacle was used.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Received the Nova Pentacle from the druid Chaney in 4074 AR.

entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: Druid who gave the pentacle to Greensleeves.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Invisibly stole the pentacle and made copies.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: Controller of spellcasters who resisted Greensleeves's summoning.

entities.name: Shield of the Ice Prince
entities.description: Item reflected back at a priest of Yawgmoth by the pentacle.

events.summary: Samiks, dying of plague after being poisoned by Lim-Dûl, gives the pentacle to Zaraya.
events.quote: After Samiks was poisoned by Lim-Dûl and dying of plague, he gave the artifact to Zaraya

events.summary: Zaraya gives it to Freyalise for Jaeuhl Carthalion to use against Tevesh Szat; he reflects the Shield of the Ice Prince.
events.quote: He used the pentacle to reflect the Shield of the Ice Prince back at a priest of Yawgmoth .

events.summary: Greensleeves receives the pentacle from the druid Chaney.
events.quote: Greensleeves received the Nova Pentacle from the druid Chaney

events.summary: Towser invisibly steals the pentacle and makes copies.
events.quote: Towser invisibly stole the Nova Pentacle from Greensleeves and created several copies of it
